text:
nina: hi all, nina here, first day on runtime. trying to build from source using the repo's devcontainer on Ubuntu 22.04 host. build fails at link with missing cublas symbols.

nina: link error snippet:
```
/usr/bin/ld: CMakeFiles/runtime.dir/src/kernels/cuda_kernels.o: in function `init_cublas':
undefined reference to `cublasCreate_v2'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

maria: welcome! :wave: quick thing: inside the devcontainer run `ldd build/runtime | grep cublas` to confirm. If it says "not found" you need libcublas on the image or a CUDA toolkit with targets installed.

kevin: also check `ls /usr/local/cuda-*/targets/x86_64-linux/lib | grep cublas` and `readlink -f /usr/local/cuda-*/lib64/libcublas.so*` to see real filenames. We prefer installing the matching toolkit rather than symlinking, but temporary symlinks help debug.

nina: `ldd` shows libcublas.so.12 => not found. The devcontainer image didn't have the full toolkit, only driver libs.

maria: if you're using host-mounted CUDA toolkits make sure the container's LD_LIBRARY_PATH includes the mounted path. For cmake, add `-DCMAKE_BUILD_RPATH=/usr/local/cuda-12.2/lib64` so binaries find libs without env hacks.

infra-bot: infra-bot: If you need a shared GPU dev VM, open request in #eng-infra with tag `gpu-devbox`. Include username and desired CUDA version.

nina: i'm on an M1 laptop and was trying the container locally. sounds like i should spin up a linux VM with GPU. can infra approve a small instance for onboarding? also which exact CUDA/cuDNN versions match CI?

kevin: CI images use CUDA 12.1 + cuDNN 8.9 and drivers >=525. We keep a pinned docker image internally `redwood/dev:cuda-12.1-cudnn8` you can ask infra to grant access. Avoid mixing toolkit minor versions.

maria: last tip: run `git submodule update --init --recursive` before building. Our cuda wrappers are sometimes hidden in submodules and cause mysterious link failures.

dev-bot: dev-image-bot: recommended local setup: use provided docker dev image or request GPU VM. Docs: https://redwood.dev/dev-env.

nina: thanks — i'll request a gpu devbox and try the internal image. pinging infra now. appreciate the quick help! :thumbsup:
